snippet.title: Frostpunk 1886 | New Game Announcement
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce #Frostpunk1886.

Rebuilt in Unreal Engine, expanded with a completely new Purpose Path, the long-awaited mod support, and more - all the while staying true to the legacy of the original.

Still about survival, sacrifice, and about the people of New London 🤍
